intro: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is a narrative-driven RPG that tells of the hardships of a commoner's Lot in a realm of dark fantasy.
description:
Join the main character, Sir Brante, on a journey through the various stages of life and guide your protagonist as his personality is being forged by the cruel injustices of a society divided by class and ruled by outdated traditions. This is a story of a merciless world that punishes those who violate its laws... and the one man who dares to challenge the old order.

Born a commoner with no rights or title, you were never fated for an easy existence. Changing your destiny and becoming a true heir to the Brante family name will put you at odds with the ancient customs and foundations. Go the distance from birth until true death, writing a history of great upheavals, monumental experiences, and difficult choices.

- A narrative RPG with a vibrant, dark fantasy adventure plot
- Every event has multiple possible outcomes, and only you decide which path Sir Brante should follow
- Make any choice you want but beware the unpredictable consequences wrought on by hasty decisions
- Influence the course of history and participate in events that reshape the world around you
- Savor the dark and gritty atmosphere of the Blessed Arknian Empire, where the laws are harsh, gods know little mercy, and everyone's Lot is predetermined by their estate
- Unravel an engaging storyline and accompany your character the whole way through, from birth until his demise

Key features:

Gripping narrative
The gods once bestowed the truth of the Lots unto the realm of mortals, and the Imperial law now demands that every person's life be determined by their estate. The nobles rule, the clergy offer counsel and punish those led astray from the one true path, while the common folk suffer and toil away for the glory of the Empire. You may accept this fate, but it is also within your power to alter the existing world order forever.

Your choice is not an illusion
All of your character's deeds, acquired skills, and the consequences of his actions add up to form a plot that is unique to the current playthrough. Every decision has a price, and you will be held accountable throughout the entire journey. Protect your family and loved ones, reach out for the reins of the state, or challenge the old order – make your choice and witness the aftermath.

Fight for survival
Train your character, cultivating traits such as determination, sensitivity, or endurance. All of the hero's skills will affect his personality, worldview, and relationships, ultimately unlocking new talents and possible storylines in this dark fantasy world!


A path full of hardships
The first complete walkthrough can take you upwards of 15 hours! Numerous branching paths that affect the unfolding story will make every playthrough a unique experience: become a noble judge, learn the ways of the inquisition, plot a revolution as a member of a secret society, or embrace an entirely different purpose. Destiny itself shall bend to your will!

Strive for survival in the harsh reality of dark fantasy! Walk a path full of danger and adventure, take risks, and find your own way in the universe of The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante!
